east-africa.title: Bariga Afrika
east-africa.description: Kenya, Tansaaniya, Yugaandha, Itoobiya, Ruwaanda, Burundi, Soomaaliya iyo Koonfur Suudaan — Nayroobi, Dar es Salaam, Addis Ababa, Kampala, Kigali, Mombasa, Sansibaar, Buurta Kilimanjaro, Serengeti iyo Harada Fiktooriya.

horn-of-africa.title: Geeska Afrika
horn-of-africa.description: Itoobiya, Soomaaliya, Eritreya, Jabuuti, Koonfur Suudaan iyo waqooyiga Kenya — Addis Ababa, Muqdisho, Asmara, Magaalada Jabuuti, Juba; dhulka sare ee Itoobiya, Dooxada Rift, xeebta Badda Cas.

south-central-us.title: Koonfurta Bartamaha Maraykanka
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi iyo Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson iyo Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samowa iyo Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samowa, Samowada Maraykanka, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, iyo Wallis iyo Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi iyo Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila iyo jasiiradaha Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam iyo Jasiiradaha Waqooyiga Mariana
mariana-islands.description: Guam iyo Jasiiradaha Waqooyiga Mariana — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian iyo Rota.

greenland.title: Griinlaand
greenland.description: Griinlaand — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq iyo Tasiilaq; barafka weyn ee dhulka, Ilulissat Icefjord iyo fjord-yada koonfurta.

bermuda.title: Bermuuda
bermuda.description: Bermuuda — Hamilton, St. George’s iyo Royal Naval Dockyard, degmooyinka jasiiradda iyo xeebaheeda ciidda casaanka khafiifka ah.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno iyo Brest; kaynta Belovezhskaya Pushcha iyo dhiijada Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Jasiiradaha Channel
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark iyo Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port iyo Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Jasiiradaha Faroe
faroe-islands.description: Jasiiradaha Faroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík iyo siddeed iyo tobanka jasiiradood, tuulooyinkooda, tunnelladooda iyo dhagaxyada dheer ee badda.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard iyo Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg iyo Ny-Ålesund; barafleyda iyo fjord-yada Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo iyo Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria iyo Saddexda Magaalo.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaskar iyo Jasiiradaha Badweynta Hindiya
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaskar, Komoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Morishiyos iyo Seyshelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis iyo Victoria.

sudan.title: Suudaan
sudan.description: Suudaan — Khartuum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid iyo Nyala; isugeynta Niilka Buluugga ah iyo Niilka Cad iyo ahraamta Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria iyo tobanka jasiiradood, laga bilaabo Santo Antão ilaa Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: Saw Tome iyo Prinsipe
sao-tome-principe.description: Saw Tome iyo Prinsipe — São Tomé, Santo António iyo kaymaha roobka iyo xeebaha labada jasiiradood.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension iyo Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Jasiiradda Ascension iyo Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown iyo Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangaladheesh
bangladesh.description: Bangaladheesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet iyo Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans iyo deltada Ganges–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka iyo Maldiifta
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka iyo Maldiifta — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura iyo Malé; dhulka buuraleyda ah, Sigiriya iyo jasiiradaha atoll-ka.

vietnam.title: Fiyetnaam
vietnam.description: Fiyetnaam — Hanoi, Magaalada Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An iyo Can Tho; Gacanka Ha Long iyo deltada Mekong.

philippines.title: Filibiin
philippines.description: Filibiin — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio iyo Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao iyo Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indoneesiya iyo Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indoneesiya iyo Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar iyo Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi iyo Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysiya, Singabuur iyo Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysiya, Singabuur iyo Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singabuur, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching iyo Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine iyo Harada Inle; dooxada Irrawaddy iyo buuraha Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kamboodiya iyo Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kamboodiya iyo Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap iyo Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang iyo Pakse; webiga Mekong iyo Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolombiya
colombia.description: Kolombiya — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena iyo Bucaramanga; buuraha Andes, xeebta Kariibiyaanka iyo Amazon.

venezuela.title: Fenesuweyla
venezuela.description: Fenesuweyla — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida iyo Ciudad Bolívar; Biyo-dhaca Angel, webiga Orinoco iyo Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Beeru
peru.description: Beeru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos iyo Puno; Machu Picchu, Harada Titicaca iyo Dooxada Barakaysan.

ecuador.title: Ikwadoor
ecuador.description: Ikwadoor — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta iyo Baños; Waddada Volkaanooyinka, Amazon iyo Jasiiradaha Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Boliifiya
bolivia.description: Boliifiya — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre iyo Potosí; Harada Titicaca iyo Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Jili
chile.description: Jili — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena iyo Punta Arenas; Atacama, Gobolka Harooyinka, Patagonia iyo Jasiiradda Easter.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Baraguway iyo Uruguway
paraguay-uruguay.description: Baraguway iyo Uruguway — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este iyo Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Guyaanayaasha
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname iyo Guyaanada Faransiiska — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne iyo Kourou; Biyo-dhaca Kaieteur iyo kaynta roobka ee Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Jasiiradaha Falkland
falklands.description: Jasiiradaha Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green iyo jasiiradaha East Falkland iyo West Falkland.

australia.title: Awstaraaliya
australia.description: Awstaraaliya — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin iyo Canberra; Great Barrier Reef, Uluru iyo Outback.

new-zealand.title: Niyuu Siilaand
new-zealand.description: Niyuu Siilaand — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin iyo Queenstown; Buuraha Alps ee Koonfurta, Fiordland iyo Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George iyo Whistler; Buuraha Xeebta, Jasiiradda Vancouver iyo Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Bannaanada Kanada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan iyo Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina iyo Banff; Buuraha Rockies, bannaanada iyo Churchill oo ku taal Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston iyo Thunder Bay; Biyo-dhaca Niagara, Harooyinka Waaweyn iyo Beerta Algonquin.

quebec.title: Kebek
quebec.description: Kebek — Montréal, Magaalada Kebek, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke iyo Saguenay; webiga St. Lawrence, buuraha Laurentians iyo Jasiirad-gacmeedka Gaspé.

atlantic-canada.title: Kanadada Atlantigga
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, iyo Newfoundland iyo Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton iyo Charlottetown; Cabot Trail iyo Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Waqooyiga Kanada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories iyo Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City iyo Inuvik; jasiiradaha Arctic Archipelago iyo webiga Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong iyo Makaaw
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong iyo Makaaw — Jasiiradda Hong Kong, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau iyo Jasiirad-gacmeedka Makaaw, Taipa iyo Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antarktika
antarctica.description: Antarktika — Saldhigga McMurdo, Saldhigga Scott iyo Villa Las Estrellas; Jasiirad-u-ekaha Antarktika, jasiiradaha South Shetland, Ross Ice Shelf iyo Buurta Erebus. Khariidaddu waxay ku dhammaataa 85° koonfur mana gaarto Cirifka Koonfureed.
